svg.title: SD-004: Task Delegation Chain (default OOAD workflow v2.0.0)

g.text: SD-004: Task Delegation Chain (default OOAD workflow v2.0.0)
Each agent hands its output to the next through workflow variables
orchestrator.invokeAgent(role, context). The strategy's typed output
(BaOutput, QcOutput, ...) is merged into the run's variables, so the next
agent and the condition nodes read it (code, qcReport, qa_approved).
Agents never call each other directly.
task.create(...) (one per use case, status todo)
jest --json on projects/<id> (read-only mount, no network)
: CEO → BA → Architect → [OOAD gate] → PM → DEV → QC → QA → [qa_approved] → Marketing → [approval] → CEO
Backward edges: gate fail → Architect, QA reject → DEV.
QC (product: tests, traceability) and QA (process: design conformance) form a review chain.
